notes: REF-BM-03: title/description editable after saving via edit dialog, but the add form has no title/description fields, so pre-save editing is absent. REF-BM-10: tag entry is a plain comma-separated text input with no autocomplete; the /api/tags dropdown is only a filter, not entry autocomplete. REF-BM-12: search LIKE covers title, url, description only — notes are excluded. REF-BM-14: no #tag parsing in the query; only a separate tag param. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag in schema or code. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list is always ordered by date_saved DESC; no sort key/UI. REF-BM-23: notes are stored and shown as escaped plain text with a 📝 prefix, not rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or PDF/Internet-Archive handling. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag; delete only. REF-BM-29: no bundle entity. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings entity or endpoints.
